scientific_interpretation_boundary: These are STRUCTURAL statistics of the frozen recipe banks. They do not measure semantic plausibility or a causal role of LLM reasoning. A semantic-mechanism reading is only supported downstream if E6 LLM-SHUFFLE reduces performance or a per-attack-family mapping is plausible (spec 8).
